atomic_boundary.counterexample: Process stops after successful rename and before state=candidate. Durable path contains candidate; old memory no longer survives. Fresh load must observe committed history once. BP04 blanket old-bytes/state requirement cannot hold at this boundary.
atomic_boundary.required_precommit: Before successful rename: old authoritative path/state unchanged; leftover temp ignored
atomic_boundary.required_postcommit: After successful rename: valid new committed sidecar authoritative on reload; do not rollback a committed fact solely because UI acknowledgement was absent; duplicate grants forbidden
